name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Senior Partnership Enablement Specialist with 8+ years of experience acting as the strategic interface between Product teams and partner ecosystems. Proven track record translating technical product updates into clear business narratives, high-impact use cases, and enablement sessions that accelerate partner adoption. At Wipro (Meta Project), built the regional partner enablement program from scratch, taking the operation to #1 globally in adoption growth. Fluent English, based in Curitiba, AI-first mindset, and strong analytical skills to identify co-innovation opportunities within partner ecosystems.

bullets: Partner Enablement & Adoption (#1 Global): Served as the strategic liaison between Meta product teams and regional commercial partners. Translated technical product updates into business narratives, use cases, and enablement materials — driving adoption +150% and achieving #1 globally in adoption growth.

Product Briefings & Enablement Sessions: Conducted regular briefings on new platform features and capabilities for partner teams. Developed argumentation guides, scripts, and prompt libraries that equipped partners to confidently position solutions.
Partner Ramp-up (-50%): Built the partner onboarding and certification program (Next Level Bootcamp), reducing time-to-productivity from 6 to 3 months (-50%) with 90%+ audit quality scores.

Use Case Development & B2B Partners: Developed use cases and positioning materials for onboarding B2B local partners (establishments), mapping high-impact opportunities and aligning partners to the platform value proposition.
Strategic Outreach: Structured outreach campaigns and communication sequences to introduce new platform capabilities to partners, growing the active partner base.
Product-to-Partner Translation (40+ Projects): Served as the link between product and market for 40+ clients, documenting success use cases, competitive positioning, and co-selling materials.
Outreach & Conversion (+250%): Structured outreach campaigns that grew qualified partner leads from 8 to 20-30/month (+250%).

Educational Partner Enablement (~R$ 50k): Enabled facilitators and partners in the Thinking Environment methodology, developing positioning materials and use cases that generated R$ 50,000 in revenue.
Product Launch & Ecosystem: Led the GTM of the first digital product (LMS), mapping strategic partners and securing 50 sales in the first 2 months.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree and Licentiate in Philosophy
